title: Live updates are switched on in RKN Suite
body: This tab now shows verified changes to prices, launches, handovers, metro lines and rules. Each item links to its official source and is reviewed by RKN before it appears.

title: Dubai property deals reach AED 574 bn in the first nine months of 2026
body: Dubai Land Department data shows 165,018 transactions worth AED 574.12 bn from January to September 2026, including AED 379.4 bn of sales, the second-highest nine-month sales value on record. September alone saw AED 50.78 bn across 16,490 deals, and Business Bay was the top-selling area at over AED 20 bn.

title: Namma Metro Pink Line: safety inspection of first 7.5 km set for 6–8 October
body: The metro safety commissioner is due to inspect the elevated stretch from Kalena Agrahara to Tavarekere along Bannerghatta Road, with six stations: Kalena Agrahara, Hulimavu, IIMB, JP Nagar 4th Phase, Jayadeva Hospital and Tavarekere. Passenger service can start only after clearance, so mid-October is the earliest possible opening; earlier deadlines have slipped several times.

title: Etihad Rail passenger service formally launched
body: Formal launch on 30 Sep 2026 after the introductory phase from 30 Jun. Dubai's station is at Al Yalayis; Abu Dhabi to Dubai takes about 57 minutes. Al Dhafra stations follow by 30 Dec 2026 and Sharjah by 30 Mar 2027.

title: Prestige launches Prestige Parklane on STRR, Devanahalli
body: 1,788 homes (1, 2 and 3 BHK) across nine towers on 11.91 acres, with about 1.7 million sq ft of saleable area and an estimated development value of ₹1,750 crore. Confirm the K-RERA number and current price list with Prestige before sharing with clients.

title: Seven Dubai Metro stations now go by new names
body: Under RTA's naming-rights programme, Onpassive is becoming Garmin, and recent renames include UAE Exchange to Life Pharmacy, Jabal Ali to National Paints, Al Khail to Al Fardan Exchange, GGICO to Al Garhoud, Mashreq to Insurance Market and Al Fahidi to Sharaf DG. RKN Suite 2.15.0 shows both the new and old names.

title: Godrej Vanantara sold over ₹2,000 crore in its launch week
body: Godrej Properties reported more than 1,000 homes sold in the first week of June 2026 at its 36-acre project off Bannerghatta Road, one of the strongest launches in South Bengaluru.

title: Dubai 2-year investor visa: no minimum property value for sole owners
body: Dubai Land Department removed the earlier AED 750,000 minimum for the two-year property investor residence visa when the property has a single owner. For joint ownership, each owner's share must be worth at least AED 400,000. The 10-year Golden Visa still needs AED 2 million in property.

title: Dubai Metro Gold Line approved: 42 km, 18 stations, opening 2032
body: The Ruler of Dubai approved the fully underground Gold Line from Al Ghubaiba to Jumeirah Golf Estates, via Mina Rashid, City Walk, Business Bay, MBR City, Nad Al Sheba, Meydan, Al Barsha South and JVC. Cost is about AED 34 bn, with a target opening of 9 September 2032.
area: Business Bay, Meydan, JVC, Jumeirah Golf Estates

title: RTA invites designers for the DXB–DWC Airport Express Line
body: A planned ~55 km express link from DXB via Al Jaddaf, Al Khail Road and JVC to Al Maktoum International, with five stations offering airline check-in and bag drop. Still at design stage.

title: Dubai shared housing law: a permit is now needed to share or sub-let units
body: Law No. 4 of 2026 requires a Dubai Municipality permit before any property is used for shared housing, with contracts handled through the Dubai Land Department's registry. It takes effect 180 days after publication in the Official Gazette, existing operators get one year to comply, and fines run from AED 500 to AED 500,000 (up to AED 1 million for repeat violations).

title: Dubai Loop tunnel construction begins
body: Phase 1 is a 6.4 km tunnel with four stations from DIFC to Burj Khalifa / Dubai Mall, cutting the trip from about 20 to 3 minutes. Phase 1 is expected to open in 2027.

title: K-RERA fines builders who skip annual audit reports
body: Every promoter must file a CA-certified annual audit report for each registered project. K-RERA charges yearly penalties from ₹20,000 (projects up to ₹25 crore) to ₹1 lakh (above ₹100 crore) for missing reports, with action on 2023-24 defaulters from 1 April 2026. Check a project's filings on the K-RERA portal before recommending it.
